great.name: Room rent: No limit / any room (base hospitalization)
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: Indicates no default room rent capping under the base hospitalization benefit (you can choose any room). Note: a separate optional 'Room Type Modification' can introduce room eligibility + co-pay if you choose it.

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer / unlimited restoration (ReAssure+ / ReAssureX)
great.quote: “Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: Provides additional Sum Insured that activates after a claim and can trigger unlimited times across the life of the policy (per-claim payout from ReAssure is up to Base Sum Insured).

great.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: as low as 12 months (variant-based)
great.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 12months/24 months/ 36 months (as per Variant selected) of continuous coverage...”
great.explanation: Best variants offer 12-month PED waiting, which is better than market standard. (Other variants may be 24/36 months.)

great.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: as low as 12 months (variant-based)
great.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 24 months/12 months (as per Variant Selected) of continuous coverage...”

great.explanation: Best variants offer 12-month waiting for listed specific diseases/procedures (better than standard 24 months).

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (standard)
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident...”
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illness; accidents covered from day 1.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: “...for 60 days before the date of admission...”
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 60 days prior to admission if the hospitalization claim is paid.

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 180 days after discharge if the hospitalization claim is paid.

good.name: Modern treatments covered (listed), up to Base Sum Insured

good.explanation: Covers specified modern treatments but with a limit of up to Base Sum Insured (not an extra/additional benefit beyond SI).

good.name: Domiciliary / home care treatment covered (with conditions)
good.quote: “Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home which in normal course would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home provided that...”
